attributes.board_name: Colorado State Board of Marriage and Family Therapist Examiners

rules.new_licensee_rule: Licensees receiving an original, reinstated or reactivated license during the cycle accrue 1.66 PDH per month (or part) licensed.
rules.alternatives: Deem Status for participants in a qualifying Colorado state department professional development program; active-duty military exemption.
rules.audit_note: Audits are conducted after the renewal period ends; keep CPD documentation (rubric/survey, Learning Plan, PDA records) for 5 years from the license expiration date.
rules.accepted_credit_types: Board-approved Professional Development Activities: volunteering, mentoring, presenting, supervision, publishing, coursework, independent and group learning
rules.carryover: Up to 5 PDH earned within 3 months before expiration and above the 40 may be carried to the next cycle.
rules.notes: Continuing Professional Development program: Professional Practice Survey, Learning Plan, then 40 PDH. Max 20 PDH per single activity type. No mandated subjects found in the rule. Licenses expire Aug 31 of odd-numbered years.
